# Guides

Source: [https://thefellow.github.io/guides/](https://thefellow.github.io/guides/)

## Pyramid summary

- **~2 words:** Practical guides
- **~8 words:** Long-form guides turning architecture principles into testable working designs.
- **Expanded:** Long-form guides turning architecture principles into testable working designs.

## Full content

Long-form tutorials connect design principles to running code. Each series is structured so written chapters can stand on their own and later pair with video walkthroughs.

- [Building High-Quality Software](/guides/building-high-quality-software/) ([Markdown](/guides/building-high-quality-software.md)): A preview of eleven lessons about turning architectural intent into executable constraints, using Mixology as the worked example.
- [Building an Application TUI Toolkit](/guides/building-an-application-tui-toolkit/) ([Markdown](/guides/building-an-application-tui-toolkit.md)): How Mixology combines proven MVVM ideas with Bubble Tea's message loop to create a consistent, testable terminal application without inventing another framework.
